dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The mid-lateral flank features a network of irregular, interconnected 'O' and 'C' shaped structures with sharply defined, high-contrast light-grey perimeters that transition abruptly into lighter interior centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate density of small, high-intensity white pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily distributed along the upper dorsal midline and the base of the caudal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest annuli on the central flank form an obtuse scalene triangle; a secondary cluster of four high-intensity blobs on the posterior dorsal surface forms a narrow trapezoidal configuration.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A high-visibility red/orange artificial identification tag is attached to the trailing edge of the hind flipper; localized orange-brown pigmentation or possible lesion is present on the right lateral aspect of the muzzle.
